properties.name: A design closes against a threshold the owner declares, and the closure report names the first hole
properties.rationale: Requirement 3 of the three intents Anthony accepted on 2026-09-16 ("need to ensure that designs close and are verified"), built 2026-09-17 after #528 on his word ("After merging 528, then let's start on requirement 3"). The lesson carried from the two increments before it: a leg with nothing to run on must say so rather than read clean, and the threshold is the owner's word, never a default — 100% and "traceability and budgets only" are both declarations. Closure is a report and never a gate, so a release cut while the design does not close is recorded as exactly that.
properties.summary: closure_report (core closure.rs, served in the coherence router) sums five computations that already exist — requirement_is_delivered per live requirement, budget_report per Constraint with a limit (now against a declared margin too), seam_coverage, the GOVERNED_BY / SCHEDULED_FOR read what_next scores, and the provenance sweep the detector uses — into one read: each leg says what it swept, its share and its worst offender; a counted leg that swept nothing does not close and says so; first_hole is the first leg in the DECLARED order that fails. Project.closure_legs and Project.closure_threshold are declared with set_closure_criterion (validated against the five legs; no default); no declaration reads no_closure_criterion_stated. closure_criterion_undeclared asks once on a design with live requirements. Constraint.margin added; add_constraint accepts it; set_constraint_margin sets it. release_report carries a ClosureSummary beside its own answer. detect_quantity_provenance refactored onto the shared quantity_provenance_sweep so the detector and the leg cannot disagree. Skills: genesis asks what done means; where-am-i gathers and tells the closure line; detect-and-ask has the row. Tests: a_design_closes_against_a_declared_threshold.rs (core, nine cases) and a_closure_criterion_is_declared_on_the_served_surface.rs (served, three).
